definitions.ask: Should bob-navigation-hotkeys turn on Templater's device-local new-file trigger itself when unset?
definitions.why: bob-* plugins deploy per device, so syncing them is already Templater's per-device trust step

choices.label: Turn it on at startup with a notice; each device fixes itself after `bob plugins sync`
Leave it off; show a sticky notice and a command, so each device needs one manual step
